city.zh: 美國佛羅里達州多拉爾（邁阿密）

title.en: South Africa excluded from the Miami G20
title.zh: 南非被排除在邁阿密G20峰會之外

summary.en: The US presidency did not invite South Africa, a founding G20 member, to its 2026 meetings, sparking debate about who decides G20 membership.
summary.zh: 美國主席國未邀請G20創始成員南非參加2026年會議，引發「誰能決定G20成員資格」的爭論。

question.en: Should a host country be able to exclude a member of an informal group like the G20?
question.zh: 主辦國是否應有權排除G20這類非正式組織的成員？

title.en: US narrows G20 agenda to growth, energy, AI
title.zh: 美國將G20議程聚焦於成長、能源與AI

summary.en: The US presidency wants the G20 to focus on three themes: cutting regulation, affordable energy supply chains, and AI and new technologies.
summary.zh: 美國主席國希望G20聚焦三大主題：減少法規負擔、確保可負擔的能源供應鏈，以及人工智慧與新興科技。

question.en: Which global problems might get less attention if the G20 agenda becomes narrower?
question.zh: 若G20議程變窄，哪些全球問題可能被忽略？

title.en: Experts warn of a divided Miami summit
title.zh: 專家警告邁阿密峰會恐出現分歧

summary.en: Economists at PIIE warned that differences over the agenda could lead to a summit without a shared leaders' declaration.
summary.zh: 彼得森國際經濟研究所的學者警告，議程分歧可能使峰會無法達成共同的領袖宣言。

question.en: Does the G20 still matter if its members cannot agree on a joint statement?
question.zh: 如果成員無法發表共同聲明，G20還有存在意義嗎？
